mechanism: Triamcinolone increases nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity risk of amikacin through immunosuppression and fluid retention, while amikacin may reduce triamcinolone efficacy; corticosteroids also impair aminoglycoside bactericidal activity.
action: Monitor renal function (BUN, creatinine, urinalysis) and auditory function closely; consider alternative corticosteroid or aminoglycoside if possible; ensure adequate hydration and maintain lowest effective triamcinolone dose.
